subject: Senior leadership headcount clearance + Q2 hiring commitments
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed senior leadership hires for Q2 (heads + bands)

Team —

Attached is the baseline proposal for the senior leadership slate we discussed on Friday: two hires (Head of Platform Ops, VP Product Partnerships) to be committed in Q2. Key asks in the workbook:

- Headcount additions: +2 FTE (executive slots)
- Proposed comp bands: base + target OTE ranges and suggested offer structures (see tab "Bands")
- Timing: sourcing to start immediately, offers targeted by 2027-05-20

Notes: I flagged a higher-band request for the VP role because of market dynamics and the likelihood we need to match counter-offers from strategic partners. This is not yet routed for legal redlines — I wanted leadership clearance on headcount + bands before we kick recruitment.

Attachments: exec-hc-proposal-2027Q2.xlsx, comp-band-reference-2027.pdf

Next steps I propose:
1) Leadership signoff (headcount + bands) by end of day 2027-04-12
2) Recruiter (Ben Reeves) to begin outreach on 2027-04-13 if cleared
3) Finalize draft offer template once legal has redlined items (I can coordinate)

Thanks — appreciate a quick read and any constraints you want added to the slate.

—
Aditya Rao
SVP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed senior leadership hires for Q2 (heads + bands)

Aditya —

Thanks for the packet. A few quick clarifying items before I can sign off:

- Compensation: can you add the intended equity grant ranges per band (even as a range), and clarify whether the VP role will be offered with an accelerated vesting kicker for strategic hires?
- Budget runway: confirm these two hires fit within the Q2 talent budget (assuming existing offers across org are filled) — if this requires re-prioritizing one of the product IC hires, I need that call now.
- Approval chain: do you want me to route to CEO for explicit approval or is a delegated signoff from me sufficient for these slots?

I want to avoid last-minute pushbacks from finance. If we can capture equity and runway numbers, I can clear the headcount pending Marcus' confirmation on market compensation.

Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed senior leadership hires for Q2 (heads + bands)

On Sun, Apr 11, 2027 at 11:05 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Aditya —
>
> Thanks for the packet. A few quick clarifying items before I can sign off:
>
> - Compensation: can you add the intended equity grant ranges per band (even as a range), and clarify whether the VP role will be offered with an accelerated vesting kicker for strategic hires?
> - Budget runway: confirm these two hires fit within the Q2 talent budget (assuming existing offers across org are filled) — if this requires re-prioritizing one of the product IC hires, I need that call now.
> - Approval chain: do you want me to route to CEO for explicit approval or is a delegated signoff from me sufficient for these slots?

Aditya / Jasmine — quick input from my side:

- Market comps: I concur that the VP role will require the top of band + signing bonus in our region to be competitive. I put a conservative estimate in the attached comp-band-reference-2027.pdf.
- Equity: recommended grants (RSU approximate values) added as comments on the Bands tab; VP range: 0.35%–0.7% (depending on experience), Head of Platform Ops: 0.20%–0.35%.
- Vesting kicker: I would reserve accelerated vesting only for partner-embedded hires; otherwise keep standard schedule to avoid setting precedent.

If Laura can approve delegation to you (Aditya) for offers up to the top of band + signing bonus, we can move quickly. Otherwise we should tag the CEO loop-in for the VP role only.

Marcus Lin
CRO (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Reeves <ben_recruit@talentbridge.com>, Elaine Sato <elaine.sato@horizonanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed senior leadership hires for Q2 (heads + bands) — clearances and next steps

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Short summary and decisions (so we have one source of truth):

1) Headcount: APPROVED — +2 executive slots for Q2 (Head of Platform Ops; VP Product Partnerships). Laura: delegated signoff to Aditya for offers within band + signing bonus.
2) Compensation bands: ACCEPTED with Marcus' market adjustments. Aditya to add equity ranges to the spreadsheet and mark if accelerated vesting is requested per candidate.
3) Timing: Ben Reeves to begin outreach on 2027-04-13. Recruiter to share candidate slate by 2027-05-01.
4) External coordination: Elaine — we discussed prioritization of the partnerships network candidate referrals; happy to take any inbound recommendations (copying Ben to coordinate).
5) Legal/Offers: Aditya will route draft-offer-template.docx to Legal for redlines. Final offer approval will be sent as a simple "approve/decline" reply to this thread so we preserve records.

Attachments included for post-thread reference: draft-offer-template.docx

Action owners:
- Aditya: post-equity ranges and submit offer template to Legal (due 2027-04-14)
- Ben: begin active search 2027-04-13, submit slate 2027-05-01
- Laura: monitor budget runway and flag any conflicts by 2027-04-20
- Marcus: confirm final comp numbers for VP by 2027-04-14

I'll mark this thread as the official clearance. If any approvals change materially, respond with a clear "REVISION" in the subject line.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference
